scenes.narration: ADHD isn't a lack of attention. It's trouble steering it.

visual.prompt: Noor sits at a cluttered desk at night, a single warm lamp beam sweeping across small floating icons around her (mail, music note, clock, phone) while she watches them thoughtfully

scenes.narration: Meet Noor. Give her a hobby she loves, and hours disappear.

visual.prompt: Noor completely absorbed building a tiny cardboard model city at a table, tools and glue around her, a wall clock behind her showing very late at night, big smile

scenes.narration: But one boring email? She can't even start it.

visual.prompt: Close-up of Noor at a laptop showing a blank email window, chin in hand, her phone buzzing beside her and a tidy to-do list ignored, tired but trying

scenes.narration: About six percent of US adults have ADHD, the CDC estimates.
Many researchers see it as a problem of regulating attention, not missing it.

visual.prompt: Abstract calm scene: a bright spotlight circle gliding over a dark navy desk full of floating small icons, with a hand-drawn arrow showing it being steered, teal and amber glow, no people

scenes.narration: People with ADHD report hyperfocus more often, though that's self-reported.

visual.prompt: Noor deeply focused at a drawing tablet inside a warm glowing tunnel of light, the rest of the room fading into soft dark shapes around her

scenes.narration: It runs in families: twin studies put heritability near seventy-four percent.

visual.prompt: Noor and her mother laugh together at a kitchen table, both with the same curly dark hair and round glasses, family photos on the wall behind them

scenes.narration: So just focus is never the whole story.

visual.prompt: Noor holds a flashlight outdoors at dusk, its beam resting on a winding path ahead, she looks calm and determined

scenes.narration: Only a qualified professional can diagnose ADHD. A video can't.

visual.prompt: Noor talks with a kind clinician in a calm bright office, plants and a notepad on the desk, both seated, a relaxed conversation

scenes.narration: If this sounds familiar, talk to a clinician. Follow for more.
